mainEntity.name: How do I prevent an AI follow-up system from emailing someone who already replied or unsubscribed?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI can draft follow-ups, but timing and content should reflect the prospect’s response status. Build checks that stop reminders when someone replies, opts out, becomes a customer, or is marked unsuitable. Keep messages useful and limited rather than repeating the same pitch. Review delayed, out-of-office, and ambiguous replies manually. Run My AI Biz’s workflow principles support approval checkpoints and exception handling, which are especially important when several channels or assistants share prospect records.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use a shared status field and real-time suppression process across every channel. Stop sequences after replies, opt-outs, purchases, or disqualification, and route unusual messages to a person. Test these controls before allowing automated follow-up.
